prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished pixel-art sprite for the original JRPG HARA: Gema Arunika. Clear readable silhouette, complete subject and equipment comfortably inside the square canvas. Three-quarter side view facing RIGHT. Full body centered, transparent padding on all sides, feet or floating anchor near bottom. Genuine transparent alpha background, no backdrop, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no logos, no frame, no UI, no sprite sheet. Square 1024x1024 composition. Subject: Piko Buih. Visual design (Indonesian): Sepatu sirip pendek, jaket gelembung sian, belati kerang transparan. Adult fantasy Trickster, element Air (Air means water), rarity 3/5.
